thread:
sarah: quick sync after the cache-stampede postmortem. we surfaced ~5 remediation items but several have no clear owners. can ppl claim and drop Jira links? also we need a RACI and a single epic to track.

kevin: i can take replica-scaling + cache warming strategy. will open a ticket and add acceptance criteria.

ellie: ill own monitoring + alert thresholds. want to change alerts to be severity-based instead of raw qps.

zara: ill do the root-cause pattern sweep across the last 90 days (tagging recurring infra vs code). will produce a short findings doc.

amir: product will coordinate customer comms and prioritization; we need to define what "done" looks like for customers.

dev-ops: temp ticket created RWF-3051 for cache warming investigation: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RWF-3051 (unassigned)

kevin: creating proper tickets now. draft template I used:

```
summary: Replica autoscale + cache warm strategy to prevent stampedes
components: infra,caching
labels: postmortem,high-priority
assignee: kevin
priority: Major
acceptance: canary run w/ 48h no regressions
```

linking to postmortem.

ellie: i propose R: ellie (monitoring), kevin (infra); A: eng-sre; C: product (amir), infra; I: oncall. also suggest 2-week ETA for monitoring, 3 weeks for infra change incl canary.

zara: agree. RACI sounds good. i'll add two tickets: RWF-3052 (pattern analysis) and RWF-3053 (runbook updates).

dev-ops: RWF-3052 and RWF-3053 created and linked to epic RWF-3100 (remediation epic). RWF-3100: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RWF-3100

amir: can we also add a recurring checklist in the epic: 1) post-deploy smoke test 2) 48h monitoring 3) rollback plan documented 4) customer note drafted.

sarah: yes. also add acceptance criteria: "30d with no sev2+ recurrence" for closure.

ellie: for alerts, i'll spike today then post thresholds. question: do we want noise suppression for low-traffic regions?

kevin: yes please. we should only alert on meaningful error-rate deltas, not QPS blips. i'll include region tags in the canary.

zara: posting initial notebook with cohorting and tags by EOD. will link to RWF-3052.

dev-ops: linked children to RWF-3100.

oncall-bot: Reminder: follow-up check-in scheduled in 7 days (2041804799).

sarah: owners recap: kevin (replica/autoscale + cache warming) -> RWF-3051/RWF-3054, ellie (monitoring/alerts) -> RWF-3053, zara (recurring-pattern analysis) -> RWF-3052, amir (product I/A). epic RWF-3100 tracks everything.

kevin: small ask  if anyone is blocked on infra tickets ping me directly. will draft canary playbook and rollback steps.

ellie: runbook PR incoming tomorrow. will keep runbook minimalist (TL;DR + one-line remediation steps).

zara: adding a recurring 60-day review card to the epic to surface regressions.

amir: product will add acceptance gating to backlog so these tickets don't get deprioritized.

sarah: perfect. i'll own the 7-day check-in and update the postmortem doc with RACI table + ticket links. thanks all.

oncall-bot: Follow-up set: 7-day check-in (2041804799). Action: postmortem owner(s) to update status before check-in.
